text: Program Description Name of the program : International Economics and Trade Duration : Four years Degree awarded: Bachelor of Economics Objectives The program is designed to educate advanced specialized personnel for doing business and management in international companies and conducting teaching and research on international trade. Requirements The students should master the basic theories in economics and management, the basic knowledge and skills of international trade, command a foreign language, and acquire the ability of analyzing and solving practical problems. After graduation, students can work in foreign economics and trade sectors, government agencies, and foreign enterprises. Learning goals Student should acquire the following knowledge and abilities: 1. Master the theories and methods of western economics and international economics; 2. Master the theories of international trade, China's foreign trade principles, policies and regulations; 3. Master the basic knowledge of social science and humanities; 4. Being able to apply the knowledge of measurement, statistics, accounting to analyzing real-world problems and conducting research; 5. Have the ability to work in international trade sectors; 6. Being proficient in a foreign language and competent in computer-based foreign activities.
